Trix (also spelled Trex or Ticks) is a compendium card game popular across the Levant and Gulf, including Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Palestine, Saudi Arabia, Syria and the United Arab Emirates. English-language rules were first documented from contributors in the region (Suad Harms, V M and others) in 2007. The game combines four trick-avoidance contracts with a fifth shedding contract similar to Fan Tan.
